rate.description: A scalar `Tensor` with the same type as x. The probability that each element is dropped. For example, setting rate=0.1 would drop 10% of input elements.
constraints: rate must have the same dtype as x

seed.description: An integer tensor of shape `[2]`. The seed of the random numbers.

rng_alg.description: The algorithm used to generate the random numbers (default to `"auto_select"`). See the `alg` argument of `tf.random.stateless_uniform` for the supported values.
constraints: rng_alg must be one of auto_select, alg, tf.random.stateless_uniform

noise_shape.description: A 1-D integer `Tensor`, representing the shape for randomly generated keep/drop flags.

output.description: A Tensor of the same shape and dtype of `x`.
